title: Intelligence Source Snapshot
description: Schema for a gated, controlled capture of a registered source. Represents a recorded capture event and its review/extraction/downstream gates, not the full scraped content. No network capture, scraping, or AI extraction is implemented in this layer. A verified official source does not make a snapshot approved.

source_id.description: Identifier of the registered source this snapshot belongs to.

captured_at.description: UTC timestamp when this snapshot/check was captured. A missing captured_at must never be treated as current.

capture_method.description: How the snapshot was captured. No live scraping is implemented in this layer.

capture_origin.description: Who/what produced the capture. Used for traceability of manual vs system captures.

capture_actor.description: Optional non-PII actor label/handle responsible for the capture (e.g. a role or service name).

source_locator.description: Stable locator of the captured source state (verified official locator or labelled manual/local reference).

official_url.description: Optional canonical official URL the capture refers to.

content_reference.description: Optional local/manual reference to the captured material. Not raw ingested content. Placeholder references must be labelled manual/local/requires-verification.

content_hash.description: Optional content hash in sha256 format (with optional 'sha256:' prefix). Only present when genuinely tied to captured content.

source_version_label.description: Optional human-readable version label for the captured source state.

freshness_status.description: Conservative freshness classification for this snapshot. Missing data must never read as current.

review_status.description: Human review state of this snapshot. A missing/not_reviewed status requires review before any downstream use.

extraction_status.description: AI extraction preparation state for this snapshot. No provider integration exists in this layer.

human_review_required.description: Must be true for snapshots that may back classification/compliance intelligence. Defaults to true.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether this snapshot may back downstream-consumable artifacts. Defaults to false.

warnings.description: Optional warnings raised when the capture is incomplete (e.g. a missing content hash).

limitations.description: Optional known limitations of this snapshot (e.g. content not ingested, no regulatory claim made).

errors.description: Optional error metadata when the capture failed or is partial.

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata for local traceability.

created_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when the snapshot record was created.

contract_version.description: Optional semantic version of the capture contract this snapshot follows.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this snapshot payload.

allOf.description: A snapshot must carry at least one locator/reference so it remains traceable to its source state.
Downstream consumption requires explicit human review approval and a usable freshness state. Official source identity alone never satisfies this.
